SELECT h.owner_id,h.event_id,h.revision,h.action,h.status,h.created_at AS occurred_at,h.start_at,h.target_id,h.target_version_id, e.id AS owned_event_id,v.id AS owned_target_version_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.id')) AS snapshot_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.revision')) AS snapshot_revision, JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.revision')) AS snapshot_revision_type, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.status')) AS snapshot_status, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.targetId')) AS snapshot_target_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.targetVersionId')) AS snapshot_target_version_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.time.startAt')) AS snapshot_start_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.createdAt')) AS snapshot_created_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.updatedAt')) AS snapshot_updated_at, p.event_id AS previous_event_id,p.revision AS previous_revision,p.status AS previous_status, (JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(h.snapshot_json,'all','$.id','$.revision','$.status','$.targetId','$.targetVersionId','$.time.startAt','$.createdAt','$.updatedAt')=1 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.id'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.revision'))='INTEGER' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.status'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.time.startAt'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.createdAt'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.updatedAt'))='STRING' AND ((h.target_id IS NULL AND h.target_version_id IS NULL AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.targetId'))='NULL' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.targetVersionId'))='NULL') OR (h.target_id IS NOT NULL AND h.target_version_id IS NOT NULL AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.targetId'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.targetVersionId'))='STRING'))) AS metadata_types_valid FROM interview_event_history h LEFT JOIN interview_event e ON e.owner_id=h.owner_id AND e.id=h.event_id LEFT JOIN interview_event_history p ON p.owner_id=h.owner_id AND p.event_id=h.event_id AND p.revision=h.revision-1 LEFT JOIN preparation_item i ON i.owner_id=h.owner_id AND i.id=h.target_id AND i.kind='TARGET' LEFT JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=h.target_version_id WHERE h.owner_id=#{owner} AND
(h.event_id=#{key.eventId} AND h.revision=#{key.revision})
